pr_title: Button shortcuts no longer "press" the Button.
pr_body:
* Button shortcuts were treated as generic input events on buttons. This means that to activate a button shortcut you had to press and release.
* This logic is removed and now shortcuts always activate on press.
* This makes the editor feel more responsive and solves problems related to this behavior.
* Shortcut feedback is kept, but it is now a timed event after press.

Fixes #45033 and possibly others.
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/40464.

issue_context.title: The "Add Child Node" button remains pressed after adding a node via shortcut
issue_context.body:
**Godot versions:**
4.0.dev 9e34ba48556b71f1f672b5be47d12b0e3f679b86
3.2.3.beta
3.2.2.stable
*Cannot* reproduce in 3.1.1.stable, regression?


**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10, GLES3


**Issue description:**
The "Add Child Node" button remains visually pressed after adding a node with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>A</kbd>.

![Annotation 2020-07-17 130200](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17108460/87774980-01a71780-c82e-11ea-80ea-9d1edfd8310f.png)

Using a [custom theme](https://github.com/Xrayez/godot-editor-settings), but I think that shouldn't affect the behavior. If it does, that's still a bug which might happen under some theme conditions.

Stumbled upon this one while testing workarounds suggested in godotengine/godot-proposals#1206.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Create empty scene.
2. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>A</kbd>, might need to do this several times.
comments: I can reproduce this on 3.2.2 as long as I'm not on the 2D tab when I press <kbd>Ctrl + A</kbd>.

Regression from 1e6fa5d1a553fdf76840762024420fba3a720e70, #25573 by @pouleyKetchoupp, what do you think could cause this? Note that before your change, the button doesn't get highlighted at all under any circumstance (if using shortcut).

@Xrayez Maybe the release event doesn't go through when there's a popup on top? That would be my first guess given the logic in `BaseButton::_unhandled_input`, but only debugging could tell.

Also it looks like it doesn't work the same way on 3.2 and master.

3.2 version:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/89f57ae12244f3269c9e3fe4684e16ec1fd2c989/scene/gui/base_button.cpp#L356-L365

Master version:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9e34ba48556b71f1f672b5be47d12b0e3f679b86/scene/gui/base_button.cpp#L338-L342
Yeah that's where I've found this at least... It's not high priority though.

I found this as well when working on #42109. I can only get it to replicate in one scenario - but in this scenario the window does not popup at all, and the button stays pressed.

Sequence of events:
1. User Holds CTRL + A.
2. Button receives press event for this action, and `status.press_attempt` is now true. By default, BaseButton is action mode ACTION_MODE_BUTTON_RELEASE so the `pressed()` method has not been called yet.
3. User releases CTRL but A is still pressed.
4. This no longer matches the action, so the button is forever in the `press_attempt` state since the button does not think it has been released.
